odia: ପଳେଇ ପଶିଲି ମାଉସୀ ଘରେ ମାଉସୀ ମାଇଲା ଦିପହରେ
title: Trouble where I sought refuge
literal_meaning: I fled into my aunt’s house; my aunt struck me at a bad time.
explanation: The first-person speaker runs towards a relative and meets another blow. Our reading follows that reversal: the hoped-for refuge adds to the trouble. The quotation follows the headword’s “bad time” sense; its other senses are noon and midnight, so a precise clock time is not established here. The line gives one sharp scene, not a verdict on aunts.
meaning_odia: କଥକ ପଳାଇ ସମ୍ପର୍କୀୟଙ୍କ ଘରେ ପଶିଲେ, ସେଠି ପୁଣି ମାଡ଼ ଖାଇଲେ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଆଶ୍ରୟର ଆଶା ଓ ନୂଆ ବିପଦର ଓଲଟା ଚିତ୍ର ଅଛି। ଉଦ୍ଧୃତିଟି ଅଭିଧାନର ଅସମୟ ଅର୍ଥ ପରେ ଆସିଛି; ଅନ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ ମଧ୍ୟାହ୍ନ ଓ ଅର୍ଦ୍ଧରାତ୍ର। ତେଣୁ ଏଠି ଘଣ୍ଟାର ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ସମୟ ଧରାଯାଇନାହିଁ। ଗୋଟିଏ ତୀକ୍ଷ୍ଣ ଘଟଣା ସବୁ ମାଉସୀଙ୍କ ବିଚାର ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: Our reading follows refuge turning into further trouble.
odia_summary: ଆଶ୍ରୟ ଖୋଜି ଆଉ ଦୁଃଖ ପାଇବାର ଓଲଟା ଚିତ୍ର।
usage_example: Original imagined example: After a difficult committee meeting, someone asks a friend for help drafting a reply. The friend begins another scolding. “ପଳେଇ ପଶିଲି ମାଉସୀ ଘରେ…” the visitor says ruefully. Here the added blow is criticism; that nonliteral setting is our invention.
cultural_context: The dictionary’s placement guides this translation without erasing its multiple time senses. The example transfers physical violence into verbal disappointment; it does not approve either.
